importStatement.heroText: Download a statement from your bank app or net banking, then pick it here. One import fills in a whole month at once.
importStatement.whereToFindBullet1: HDFC / ICICI / Axis — net banking → Account Statement → download as PDF, CSV or Excel
importStatement.whereToFindBullet2: SBI — YONO or net banking → Account Statement → PDF or CSV
importStatement.whereToFindBullet3: Emailed statements — the monthly PDF your bank sends works too
importStatement.passwordProtectedNote: Password-protected PDFs are fine — we'll ask for the password. If a PDF can't be read, your bank's CSV export is the most accurate option.
importStatement.footnote: Tap a category chip to change it. Uncheck anything that shouldn't be imported.
importStatement.pdfProtectedMessage: Enter the password your bank uses for this statement. It's often your date of birth as DDMMYYYY, or your PAN in lower case.

importStatement.fileTooLarge: This file is too large to upload. Try exporting a shorter date range.
importStatement.noTransactionsFoundPdf: No transactions could be read from this PDF. Your bank's CSV export is more reliable.
